name: Rozzano (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rozzano (a black lion above waves) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Rozzano, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Rozzano arms — black lion above waves, crowned, within branches
